issues.title: Dangling Subfolder References
issues.why: The overview lists 16 subfolders (e.g., 07-csharp, 09-powershell), but the provided context only includes the root and 01-cross-language. A mediocre AI cannot resolve the specific rules for C#, Go, or Rust without these files.
issues.fix: Provide the 00-overview.md and 97-acceptance-criteria.md for all language-specific subfolders listed in the categories table.

issues.title: Legacy AC Scaffold Ambiguity
issues.why: The Legacy Index in 97-acceptance-criteria.md states rows are 'NO LONGER authoritative', yet several subfolders (TS, PHP, C#) are noted as having 0 GWT ACs, leaving a vacuum of testable requirements for those languages.
issues.fix: Ensure every language subfolder has at least one stub GWT AC that explicitly points to the legacy criteria as the binding contract until deepened.

issues.title: Size-Limit Exception Enforcement
issues.why: AC-CG-08 mentions 'language-specific exceptions' for size limits but doesn't define them, though AC-CG-22 (the ledger) attempts to close this. There is a slight risk of an AI hallucinating new exception types not in the ledger.
issues.fix: Change AC-CG-08 text to 'Three exempt categories defined strictly in the Size-Limit Exception Ledger (AC-CG-22)'.
